messages:
sania: heads up — AcmeAnalytics escalation: sustained 502s + auth timeouts to hosted inference in eu-west1 since ~08:12 UTC. customer sent request ids and curl output. repeating failure across regions hitting edge.

anna_support: added customer timeline & sample req ids: req=ch_01F8Z9XYZ; they see 502 + short tcp resets. customer reports spike started after ~08:11 UTC. asked for pcap/traceroute.

mike_oncall: oncall here, grabbing pcap and running quick traceroute to their agent IP. I can reproduce 502s from our eu-west1 public gateway.

mike_oncall: traceroute:

```
traceroute to api.hosted.redwood-eu-west1.example (35.201.12.34), 30 hops max, 60 byte packets
 1  gw-eu1 (10.10.1.1)  0.42 ms  0.38 ms  0.36 ms
 2  isp-peering (203.0.113.5)  1.8 ms  10.2 ms  9.9 ms
 3  provider-as64500 (198.51.100.17)  12.9 ms  11.4 ms  45.2 ms  <-- flapping rtt
 4  provider-agg (198.51.100.18)  200.3 ms  *  210.1 ms  <-- packet loss / ECN marking?
 5  api-edge (35.201.12.34)  12.1 ms  12.0 ms  11.9 ms
```

mike_oncall: saw ECN (ECT) bits set in packets, and bursts of retransmits. tcpdump snippet shows repeated dup acks + retransmit window shrink:
```
08:12:03.123456 IP client > api: Flags [P.], seq 1:120, ack 1, win 64240
08:12:03.125789 IP api > client: RST
08:12:03.130000 IP client > api: Retransmission
```

james_net: I see a short BGP withdraw/announce from provider AS64500 at 08:11:58 -> route flip to backup provider AS65555. Provider reports microburst + ECN handling regen on their aggregation layer. Opening carrier ticket (ref CAR-2026-1123) and asking for pcap at their peering.

james_net: likely cause: provider's ECN/queue management misconfig during a microburst -> tail drops and TCP resets. This lines up with auth failures because token handshake often times out when TCP resets. Not a Redwood control-plane bug.

liz_sre: mitigation steps applied:
- created a temporary routing policy to steer AcmeAnalytics and affected customer prefixes to eu-west2 edge (manual canary) at 08:20 UTC
- enabled model-fallback for that customer to a smaller replica to reduce per-request concurrency
- increased proxy retry timeout and backoff for edge -> origin calls

liz_sre: result: error rate for customer dropped from ~18% 502 -> ~0.8% within 6m after traffic shift. Monitoring dash: per-route latency returned to baseline in eu-west2.

anna_support: told customer they should see improvement; they confirmed reduced errors and resumed production traffic. Customer asked for a credit; flagged to billing.

james_net: carrier escalation notes: asked provider to share interface counters (drops, ecn-marked) and config for AQM. Also requested they roll back the recent queuing knob that landed ~08:10 UTC.

sania: summary for postmortem: transient provider-side microburst + ECN handling at provider AS64500 caused tail-drop and route flapping -> TCP resets -> 502s and auth timeouts. Mitigations: route-steer to eu-west2, model fallback, increased retries. Action items: (1) get carrier RCA + counters, (2) add automated fallback routing policy when per-route 5xx spike > X for 2m, (3) review proxy handshake retry logic for token refresh during resets. Assign: james_net for carrier, liz_sre for automation, anna_support for billing credit.

mike_oncall: adding pcap and short notes to incident doc. I'll mark this as resolved for now but keeping watch for next 2 hours. :thumbsup:

carrier-bot: Carrier ticket CAR-2026-1123 opened with provider AS64500. Provider ETA for initial response: 30m.

sania: thanks everyone. please add any logs/req ids to the incident doc. we will run formal RCA after carrier data arrives.
